question: How do I connect to an office printer?
alternativePhrases: I need to add a printer
Where can I find the shared printer
answer: Use the approved printer setup instructions in the NovaTech Employee Portal and select the printer for your office location. If it is missing or shows an error, send the printer name, location, and error text to the NovaTech IT Service Desk. Do not install drivers from unofficial websites. Collect printed documents promptly.

question: What should I do when my company laptop is running slowly?
alternativePhrases: My laptop has become very slow
My work computer keeps freezing
answer: Save your work, close unused applications, and restart the device when safe. Check for approved system updates and low-storage warnings. Do not disable security software or install cleanup tools. If the problem continues, submit a NovaTech IT Service Desk ticket with the affected applications, timing, and any error messages.

question: How do I request a monitor or keyboard?
alternativePhrases: I need an external display for work
Can I get a replacement keyboard or mouse
answer: Submit an equipment request to the NovaTech IT Service Desk listing the accessory, business need, work location, and any damaged asset details. Your manager confirms the need and IT checks stock and compatibility. Wait for approval before purchasing equipment personally; reimbursement is not automatic.

question: How do I recover an accidentally deleted work file?
alternativePhrases: I deleted a document by mistake
Can IT restore a missing work file
answer: Check the recycle bin and version history in the approved storage application. If the file is unavailable, contact the NovaTech IT Service Desk promptly with the filename, original location, and approximate deletion time. Recovery depends on available backups and retention settings and is not guaranteed. Do not install recovery software or copy sensitive data to personal storage.

question: How do I get help with a video meeting audio problem?
alternativePhrases: People cannot hear me in a meeting
My meeting microphone is not working
answer: Check mute controls, select the intended microphone and speaker in the approved meeting application, and test the headset connection. Review the application's microphone permission and restart it if safe. If audio still fails, contact the NovaTech IT Service Desk with the application, device type, and test results. Never share meeting recordings containing sensitive information in a general ticket.

question: What should I do when my company mailbox is full?
alternativePhrases: I cannot receive email because storage is full
My email quota has been reached
answer: Review mailbox storage using the approved email application's tools. Archive or remove items only in accordance with the records-retention policy; do not delete material subject to a retention notice. Ask the NovaTech IT Service Desk for help if delivery is blocked or more capacity is needed. Do not forward work email to a personal account to free space.

question: How do I get help when a company laptop update fails?
alternativePhrases: My system update keeps failing
My work laptop is stuck installing an update
answer: Keep the device connected to power and follow any on-screen recovery guidance. Do not repeatedly force shutdown during an update or disable the managed update service. Contact the NovaTech IT Service Desk with the update name, error code, and how long the device has been on the same screen. IT will advise whether a restart or recovery action is appropriate.

question: Can I use a personal USB drive on my company computer?
alternativePhrases: May I plug in my own memory stick
Can I copy work files to a flash drive
answer: Do not connect personal or unknown removable drives to a company device. If removable storage is required for work, request approved encrypted media through the NovaTech IT Service Desk and obtain any required Security approval. Follow the applicable data-handling rules. Report unexpected USB devices or accidental connections through the NovaTech Security Portal.

question: How do I share confidential files with an external partner?
alternativePhrases: I need to send sensitive documents outside the company
Can I share a confidential file with a vendor
answer: Confirm the recipient's identity and business need, then obtain data-owner approval. Use the approved sharing platform with the narrowest permissions and an appropriate expiry. Check the data classification before sharing; some information cannot leave the company without additional approval. Ask Security through the NovaTech Security Portal when unsure. Do not use public links or personal email.

question: Can I use public Wi-Fi for company work?
alternativePhrases: Is airport internet safe for work
Can I connect my work laptop to cafe Wi-Fi
answer: Prefer a trusted connection or an approved hotspot. When public Wi-Fi is necessary, verify the network name, avoid automatic reconnection, and use the approved company VPN as required. Never bypass certificate warnings or endpoint controls. Avoid exposing confidential information in public spaces. Report suspicious connection behavior through the NovaTech Security Portal.

question: How do I report an email sent to the wrong recipient?
alternativePhrases: I accidentally emailed confidential data to someone else
I sent a work attachment to the wrong person
answer: Report the incident immediately through the NovaTech Security Portal, including when it occurred and the type of information involved. Use the approved recall feature if available, but do not assume recall succeeded. Follow Security instructions about contacting recipients. Do not send further copies of the sensitive material in the report or attempt to conceal the mistake.

question: Which password manager should I use for work?
alternativePhrases: Where should I store my work passwords
Can I keep passwords in a spreadsheet
answer: Use only the company-approved password manager identified in the NovaTech Employee Portal. Request installation or access through the NovaTech IT Service Desk. Do not store passwords in spreadsheets, chat messages, or unapproved browser accounts. Use unique passwords and follow MFA requirements. Access to shared credentials requires an approved vault workflow, not direct password sharing.

question: What should I do if antivirus reports a threat?
alternativePhrases: My security software detected malware
I see an endpoint protection alert
answer: Stop interacting with the suspicious file and report the alert immediately through the NovaTech Security Portal using a trusted device if necessary. Include the alert text and detection time without opening the file again. Follow Security instructions for network isolation or recovery. Do not disable protection, restore quarantined files, or install another security tool yourself.

question: How do I update my home address in employee records?
alternativePhrases: I moved house and need to change my address
Where can I edit my personal contact details
answer: Open Personal Details in the NovaTech Employee Portal and update the permitted contact fields. Complete any verification requested through the secure HR workflow. Contact HR through the portal if a field is locked. A change of address does not automatically approve a new work location; discuss remote-location implications with your manager and HR.

question: Where can I view my payslips?
alternativePhrases: How do I download a salary statement
Where is my monthly pay slip
answer: Open Payroll in the NovaTech Employee Portal and select the relevant pay period. Download statements only to a location permitted by the personal-data policy. For missing statements or access problems, submit a confidential payroll request through the portal. Do not include salary information or bank details in a general IT ticket.

question: How do I request an employment verification letter?
alternativePhrases: I need proof that I work here
Can HR provide an employment confirmation letter
answer: Submit an HR request through the NovaTech Employee Portal with the purpose, required recipient, requested deadline, and the information that must be confirmed. HR verifies the request and provides the approved form of letter. Do not draft an official company confirmation or promise a turnaround date on HR's behalf. Use secure channels for personal identifiers.

question: How do I update my emergency contact?
alternativePhrases: I need to change my next of kin details
Where do I add an emergency contact person
answer: Use the Emergency Contacts section of the NovaTech Employee Portal to add or update the person's name, relationship, and current contact details. Ensure the person knows they are listed. Check the information after saving. If editing is unavailable, contact HR through the secure portal rather than posting the details in chat or a general support ticket.

question: How do I request job-related training?
alternativePhrases: Can I attend a professional course
I want approval for a work certification
answer: Discuss the skills need with your manager and submit the learning request in the NovaTech Employee Portal with the provider, cost, dates, and business benefit. Wait for budget and attendance approval before registering. Any reimbursement or study-time arrangement must be confirmed in advance under the applicable learning policy. Do not assume passing an exam guarantees repayment.

question: How do I raise a workplace conduct concern?
alternativePhrases: I need to report bullying at work
How can I raise a harassment complaint
answer: Use the confidential HR reporting option in the NovaTech Employee Portal or contact the designated HR representative in your onboarding materials. You may contact HR directly if discussing the concern with your manager is inappropriate. Provide factual details through the confidential channel, not general chat. HR explains the review process and available support; confidentiality is handled according to the applicable process.

question: What should I do when an application license has expired?
alternativePhrases: My business software subscription expired
The tool says my license is no longer valid
answer: Open a NovaTech IT Service Desk ticket with the application name, license error, and business impact. IT checks assignment and renewal status with the application owner. Do not buy a personal subscription, use another employee's license, or enter an unapproved activation key. If work is blocked, ask for an approved temporary alternative through the same ticket.

question: How do I request temporary elevated permissions?
alternativePhrases: I need administrator rights for a work task
Can I get time-limited privileged access
answer: Submit a NovaTech Access Portal request specifying the system, exact task, justification, and required duration. Your manager and system owner must approve it, with Security review where required. IT uses the approved privileged-access process and removes access when the approved period ends. Do not bypass controls or use a colleague's administrator account.

question: How do I request access to a shared team folder?
alternativePhrases: I cannot open our department shared drive
Please give me permission to a team directory
answer: Request folder access through the NovaTech Access Portal with the folder location, business need, and whether read or edit permissions are required. The folder's data owner approves access and IT applies the approved permissions. Do not ask colleagues to copy restricted files elsewhere to bypass access controls. Report unexpected existing access to the data owner.

question: How do I correct an expense claim returned by Finance?
alternativePhrases: My reimbursement claim was sent back
Finance requested changes to my expense report
answer: Open the returned claim in the NovaTech Expense Portal and read the reviewer comments. Correct the identified fields or attach the requested supporting documents, then resubmit through the existing claim. Do not create a duplicate claim for the same expense. Use the portal's Finance query option if the reason is unclear; approval is still required before payment.

question: How do I request approval to purchase equipment for my team?
alternativePhrases: We need a purchase order for office equipment
How do I get a supplier purchase approved
answer: Obtain your manager's budget approval and submit a purchasing request through the Finance request section of the NovaTech Employee Portal. Include specifications, business need, cost center, and supplier quotation if available. Finance confirms the approved ordering process. IT equipment also requires IT review. Do not commit company funds or sign supplier terms before authorization.

question: How do I report a duplicate reimbursement payment?
alternativePhrases: I was paid twice for the same expense
My expense refund appears duplicated
answer: Contact Finance through the NovaTech Expense Portal with the claim reference, payment dates, and suspected duplicate amount. Finance will investigate and provide an approved correction process. Do not send funds to bank details received in an unsolicited email or independently offset another claim. Share payment evidence only through the secure Finance channel.

question: How do I get an office badge as a new employee?
alternativePhrases: I am a new starter and need a building pass
Where do I collect my employee entry card
answer: Your manager coordinates badge arrangements with Workplace Services before your first office visit. Follow the collection instructions in your onboarding checklist and bring the identification specified there. If arrangements are missing, contact your manager through the NovaTech Employee Portal. Do not enter using another person's badge or allow someone to bypass reception checks.

question: What should I do if an onboarding task is missing from my checklist?
alternativePhrases: My new starter checklist is incomplete
An induction activity is not listed in the portal
answer: Compare the checklist in the NovaTech Employee Portal with your manager's first-week plan. Ask your manager or HR to confirm whether the missing activity applies to your role and location. HR can correct the checklist or assign the task. Do not mark unrelated tasks complete or assume a missing security requirement is waived. Send access issues to the NovaTech IT Service Desk.

question: How do I book a meeting room?
alternativePhrases: I need to reserve a conference room
Where can I schedule an office meeting space
answer: Use the approved room-booking option listed in the NovaTech Employee Portal. Select your office, date, time, capacity, and any accessibility or equipment needs. Wait for confirmation and release the room if plans change. Contact Workplace Services for booking conflicts or faults. Follow the visitor process separately if external attendees will enter the building.

question: How do I arrange a visitor to the office?
alternativePhrases: A client is coming to our workplace
How do I register an external office guest
answer: Submit the visitor request through the Workplace Services section of the NovaTech Employee Portal before the visit. Provide only the required attendee and meeting details and wait for confirmation. Meet visitors at reception, follow badge and escort requirements, and keep restricted areas and information protected. Do not share your employee badge or entry credentials.

question: How do I report a workplace maintenance problem?
alternativePhrases: The office air conditioning is broken
I need to report damaged office furniture
answer: Submit a Workplace Services request through the NovaTech Employee Portal with the location, fault description, and its effect on work. Avoid using damaged equipment and do not attempt repairs. If there is an immediate danger, follow the local emergency procedure instead of waiting for a ticket response. Workplace Services coordinates assessment and updates the request.
